input.summary: Insert Section 12.11 requiring Harpoon to provide 90 days of post-termination transition assistance and to export AbbVie's data within 30 days.
input.comment: [Playbook] Article 12 gives Harpoon its reversion package but gives us no exit support, and Section 9.7 only requires return of Confidential Information \"as soon as reasonably practicable\" on request. We have added a short exit clause at our fallback position: 90 days of transition assistance on expiry or termination and export of our data within 30 days.

ops.text: Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Harpoon shall (a) provide AbbVie with reasonable transition assistance for a period of at least ninety (90) days following the effective date of such expiration or termination, and (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, export and deliver to AbbVie all data and Information belonging to, supplied by, or generated for AbbVie that is in Harpoon's possession or Control.
